name: text-glitch
title: Text Glitch
blurb: Text shifts and tears with animated clip-path disruptions, red and cyan shadows…
description: Renders text with layered ::before and ::after pseudos that animate clip-path insets to create a digital glitch effect. Activates continuously or on hover with configurable speed.
use_when: Cyberpunk or gaming interfaces, dystopian themes, headline text that needs aggressive visual impact.
avoid_when: Continuous body text; animation harms readability. Component hardcodes dark backgrounds.
a11y: Text is rendered in the DOM and accessible; animation cannot be paused with prefers-reduced-motion.
